svg.title: Divided Post-War Europe: Marshall Plan Recipients vs Soviet Satellite Bloc (1945–49)
svg.desc: Pearson Edexcel GCSE History map showing Western European Marshall Aid recipients ($13bn+), Greece and Turkey ($400m Truman Doctrine, March 1947), the Iron Curtain from Stettin to Trieste, Soviet satellite states bound by Cominform (1947) and Comecon (1949) including the February 1948 Czechoslovak coup, and independent Communist Yugoslavia after its 1948 split with Stalin.

g.text: prompts US Congress to pass Aid
Integrates Eastern Bloc trade; bans US aid.
launches official US policy of Containment.
EDEXCEL GCSE HISTORY · OPTION P4: CONTAINMENT vs SOVIET SATELLITE BLOC
Divided Europe: Marshall Plan vs Cominform & Comecon (1945–49)
EDEXCEL EXAM TAKEAWAY · HOW EUROPE SPLIT INTO TWO RIVAL ECONOMIC & POLITICAL CAMPS
Truman's $400m aid (Mar 1947) and the $13bn+ Marshall Plan aimed to contain communism; Stalin countered by forbidding
Eastern states from taking US 'dollar imperialism' and binding his buffer zone via Cominform (1947) and Comecon (1949).
